`anthropic-sdk.min.js` is the official `@anthropic-ai/sdk@0.127.0` bundled for the browser (MIT, see
`anthropic-sdk.LICENSE`). Rebuild with `tools/build_mobile_sdk.sh`.

`three/` and `js/orb.js` are copied in from `jarvis/hud/` by `netlify-build.sh`, so the phone and the
desktop share one 3D reactor.
